source.title: Editor: Run at column in the evaluation runs table is hardcoded English

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

On the **Evaluations** tab of a workflow, the table of past runs has a "Run at" column. Its header is written in English straight into the code, so it does not get translated.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/fa52841130f3576b50da09a55a9d1e61ae9ad5f8/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ai/evaluation.ee/components/ListRuns/RunsSection.vue#L83

The other columns next to it are already translated. They use `evaluation.listRuns.runNumber` and `evaluation.listRuns.status`.

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Open a workflow that has an evaluation set up, and go to the **Evaluations** tab.
3. Run the evaluation at least once.
4. In the table of past runs, the "Run at" header is still in English.

### Expected behavior

The column header shows in the selected language.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.46.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.46.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
